widget_map.implementation_notes:
SIZES (rule: 'same widget, four spans. Text never scales; the amount shown does.').
S 3×2: 2 links, 40px each, padding 0 14px: name (14/700, ellipsis) + 8px dot with visually hidden 'Synergy'/'Solo'. Footer Link '+<total−2> more' → full history.
M 4×3: 3 links, 56px: name over '<short date> · <short scenario>' (13 muted) + pill. Footer Link 'History · <total> sessions →'.
L 5×3: header filter radiogroup 'All' / 'Solo' / 'Synergy' (segmented, 12/700, active accsoft). 4 rows, 48px, on ONE shared grid (table or subgrid) minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto auto: name | short scenario | pill | date (tabular-nums). No footer.
XL 8×4: same filters; column header 'Routine', 'Scenario', 'Partner', 'Mode', 'Date' (12/700 uppercase 0.05em). Rows: name | long scenario | partner or '—' | pill | date. Footer '<shown> of <total> sessions' + Link 'Full history →'. Five 48px rows plus header and footer need ≈357px vs 348px: show 4 rows, use 44px rows, or compute rows = floor(available/48).
Always fetch 5 rows + count, so a resize needs no refetch; the filter refetches (URL search param or server action).
Phone: 1 row ('Flight briefing', 'Today · 787 · Night approach', 'Synergy').

new_capabilities: SIZE-CLASS REGISTRY (code, no DB). New src/lib/canvas/registry.ts and src/lib/canvas/grid.ts. Grid: 12 columns, grid-auto-rows 72px, gap 20px. At a 1212px content width a column is ≈82.67px. Span width = n×82.67 + (n−1)×20 (2→185.33, 3→288, 4→390.67, 5→493.33, 6→596, 7→698.67, 8→801.33). Span height = r×72 + (r−1)×20 (2→164, 3→256, 4→348, 5→440). WidgetDef = {id, surface 'crew'|'org_admin'|'super_admin', page, title, titleAt?: {S:'Credits'}, sizes: Partial<Record<'S'|'M'|'L'|'XL', {cols, rows}>>, defaultSize, rowsBySize (list capacity), fullView href, primaryAction, leftBar tools, allowedRoles}. Sizes are NAMED PRESETS PER WIDGET, not fixed boxes: the board's own S is 3×2 or 4×2, M is 4×3, 5×3 or 7×3, and the admin boards use 2×2, 4×4, 5×4, 6×3, 7×4, 7×5, 8×5 and 4×5. Constrain rows to 2–5 and columns to 3–12 (drop 2-column tiles or allow a 2-line title clamp). Spans render as inline style gridColumn 'span N' / gridRow 'span N'. This is allowed by the CSP (style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'), and it avoids dynamic Tailwind class names, which Tailwind v4 cannot detect. The size badge ('S · 3×2', U+00D7) shows only in resize mode.

SIZE-AWARE WIDGET CONTRACT. Each widget is a server component with props {size, data}. Its loader fetches the maximum any size needs (for example 5 rows + total count for list widgets), so a resize re-renders without a refetch. Rows shown = min(rowsBySize[size], floor((cardHeight − header − columnHeader − footer)/rowHeight)), guarding the XL overflow (357px needed vs 348px). The shared WidgetFrame provides: a header <button aria-label='Select widget: <title>'> with the drag-grip glyph, title 15/800 with ellipsis, optional subtitle (M and up), header meta slot (filters at L/XL, counts), the badge in resize mode, overflow hidden, and a footer at margin-top auto. Footers are always <Link>s to the widget's fullView. Tables at L/XL use one shared grid (a <table> using the existing .dt styles, or CSS subgrid) so columns align. Phone (<720px, the md breakpoint 45rem): a single-column stack, height auto, and a per-widget 'phone' variant; the size class is ignored. Tablet (720–1180px): clamp spans with Tailwind v4 container queries (@container on the canvas), or switch to an 8-column grid with span = ceil(span × 8/12).

PER-USER LAYOUT PERSISTENCE. New table public.user_canvas_layouts (user_id uuid not null references public.users(id) on delete cascade, surface text not null check (surface in ('crew','org_admin','super_admin')), page text not null check (page ~ '^[a-z_]{2,32}$'), layout jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(layout) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(layout) <= 64), locked boolean not null default false, layout_version int not null default 1, updated_at timestamptz not null default now(), primary key (user_id, surface, page)), with the private.set_updated_at trigger. Each entry is {w: widget id, size: 'S'|'M'|'L'|'XL', x?: 1–12, y?: ≥1, pinned: bool, hidden: bool, snoozed_until?: timestamptz}. RLS (enable): select, insert, update and delete for authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid())). Insert and update WITH CHECK also require user_id = auth.uid() and (surface = 'crew' or (surface = 'org_admin' and private.current_user_role() in ('org_admin','super_admin')) or (surface = 'super_admin' and private.is_super_admin())). Grants: following the repo's lockdown pattern, revoke all from anon and authenticated, then grant select, insert, update, delete to authenticated explicitly. Writes go through zod-validated server actions (src/app/app/canvas-actions.ts, src/app/admin/canvas-actions.ts, src/app/super/canvas-actions.ts): saveWidgetSize(page, widgetId, size), moveWidget(page, widgetId, x, y), setPinned, setHidden, setLocked, resetLayout (delete row → registry default) and arrangeLayout. Each validates widget id, size and role against the registry. No data or secrets ever go in the layout. Use optimistic concurrency on updated_at. Add negative cases to scripts/rls-check.mjs (read or write another user's layout, crew writing surface 'super_admin').

RESIZE TOOL (left bar 'Resize', aria-label 'Resize widget'). A popover radiogroup lists only the selected widget's allowed sizes, labelled with the badges ('S · 3×2', 'M · 4×3', 'L · 5×3', 'XL · 8×4'). Arrow keys choose, Enter applies, Esc cancels. Apply is optimistic: re-flow the grid and call saveWidgetSize. aria-live='polite' announces 'Recent routines resized to Large, 5 by 3'. Pointer resize handles are optional and need the keyboard path as an equivalent (WCAG 2.5.7). Phone: no Resize (the phone action sheet holds only 'Confirm', 'Past', 'Snooze', 'Pin', 'Hide').

PLACEMENT, SNAPPING, ARRANGE, PIN, LOCK. Unpinned widgets use CSS grid sparse auto-flow in layout order, which is what the concept does. Dragged or pinned widgets store explicit x/y. On resize, colliding widgets are pushed down. 'Arrange' runs a deterministic first-fit (dense) pack that skips pinned items. 'Reset' restores the registry default. 'Lock' (layout.locked) disables move, resize and arrange. Free-rectangle detection feeds the Empty grid slot ('<c> × <r> free · drop a widget here'). Keyboard move mode: Enter on the header grip → arrow keys move one cell → Enter drops, Esc cancels, with live-region feedback. If a DnD library is used it must be bundled (CSP script-src 'self'); dnd-kit-style keyboard sensors are preferred. No CDN.

WIDGET LIBRARY ('Add') AND HIDE. The library lists registry widgets for the role and page that are hidden or absent, each with a preview of its default size. 'Hide widget' sets hidden true and removes the widget from the canvas, not from the app. 'Add' unhides and places it in the first free slot at the default size. No table beyond user_canvas_layouts.

CONTEXTUAL LEFT BAR (client state only). Selection state is the widget id. The bar renders the WidgetDef tools: primary first in red (#BD2025 in the concept), then the generic 'Pin', 'Resize', 'Hide', 'Esc' ('Deselect'). It also renders the widget's leftBarDetails(size), the content dropped at smaller sizes. Examples: the Start a routine subtitle and consent sentence at S; the Credits subtitle, '<earned> / <next>', streak and weekly stats at S; Recent routines filters and count at S/M. With nothing selected it shows 'Add', 'Arrange', 'Reset', 'Lock'. Phone: it becomes a bottom sheet above the main bar.

SNOOZE (Weekly insight 'Snooze: Hide it until next week'). Stored as layout entry snoozed_until = start of next ISO week. risks: TEXT ZOOM AND CLIPPING (WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10, 1.4.12). Fixed 72px rows, overflow hidden, no in-widget scroll and 'text never scales' mean content is clipped at 200% zoom or with user text spacing. XL Recent routines already overflows at 100% (≈357px needed vs 348px). Mitigation: rows defined in rem, visible rows computed from measured height (ResizeObserver), and a switch to the single-column auto-height stack when the canvas container is narrower than 720 CSS px (zoom triggers it).

DRAG AND RESIZE ACCESSIBILITY (WCAG 2.5.7, 2.1.1). Every move and resize needs a single-pointer and keyboard path: the Resize radiogroup, keyboard move mode, and Add to place. The widget header is a <button> ('Select widget: …') that contains a grip, while widgets also contain links and forms. Selection, drag and inner controls must not nest interactives or steal focus. Announce changes via aria-live.

KEYBOARD CONFLICTS. 'Esc' deselects the widget, but Modal, Drawer, the picker popover and the guide also use Esc. Global shortcuts must not fire while typing in the Coaching form, Invite, New version textarea or Search. Define an Esc priority stack.

FOCUS OBSCURED (WCAG 2.4.11). The fixed bottom main bar, the phone selected-widget sheet (page2 shows it covering Credits text) and the floating guide card can hide focused elements. Add scroll-padding-bottom equal to the bar height and keep the guide placement rules.

COLOUR-ONLY MEANING (WCAG 1.4.1). S Recent routines dots (navy Synergy, grey Solo), tier dots and consent dots need text or visually hidden labels. Concept colours (navy #0E153E, red #BD2025, hue 275, no dark-mode values) clash with the repo tokens (--acc oklch(0.5 0.11 235), full dark theme in globals.css). New canvas tokens need dark variants, and contrast for muted #5D6278 on #F5F6FB must be checked.

PHONES AND TABLETS. The size class is desktop-only. The phone board stacks widgets in one column with no Resize, so persisted sizes must not affect phones. 720–1180px (the md to xl range) is undefined: 2-column tiles become about 120px wide. Titles already wrap at 2 columns in the page6 screenshot, against the .ell rule, and the left bar label wraps ('Nothing selecte d', page1). iOS needs 16px inputs in form widgets (existing .ctl rule) and safe-area insets for the bottom bar.

PERFORMANCE. One canvas page runs many widget loaders: the crew overview already makes 7 parallel queries plus the layout read. The super layout and overview call admin_wall_unlinked_profiles twice. Use per-widget Suspense streaming, React cache() for shared lookups (crew_directory, org stats), max-row prefetch so a resize needs no refetch, debounced layout saves with optimistic UI, and no client-side data libraries. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs before using caching or streaming APIs (Next 16 breaking changes per AGENTS.md).

CSP. Inline style spans work (style-src 'unsafe-inline'). Any DnD, popover or command-palette library must be bundled, never loaded from a CDN (script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'). Fonts must stay self-hosted via next/font (font-src 'self' data:). The concept's six-subset Manrope set is unnecessary. frame-ancestors 'none' means the iframe-based prototype board cannot be embedded for review in production.

ANONYMITY AND PRIVACY ON A GLANCEABLE CANVAS. Pinned widgets expose more on shared screens: identity mappings, candidate hints, the user's own type, and temporary passwords from Invite or New org admin. Mask hints in widgets, never render type_code on My report, and never keep temp passwords in widget or layout state. Small-n aggregates (avg credits, tier counts, research slices) can re-identify people: add minimum-n suppression. The org-admin left-bar tools 'Review' and 'Remind' on Sharing requests would cross the consent boundary and must stay aggregate.

ROLE AND RLS DRIFT. The concept puts 'Coaching' in the crew chip row and lets org admins invite 'Org admin'. Both break role limits (CREW_ROUTINES and the consent check; addUser and createOrgAdmin). Layout writes must be validated against the registry per role, but data access must stay enforced by RLS and assertRole, never by widget visibility. New tables need explicit grants (default-privilege lockdown) and negative cases in scripts/rls-check.mjs.

NAMING DRIFT ACROSS BOARDS. 'Synergy' vs 'Blind synergy'. 'Ready → Proficient' vs Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum (fixed by a check constraint). The audit action names, the gamification action_types (solo_brief, insight_read, consent_grant), the prompt families (Flight briefing/Simulator vs briefing), the token format (SKY-… vs PROF-…), the operational categories (Line pilot/Instructor/Cabin crew/Dispatcher) and the consent window (14 vs 30 days) all differ. Implementing the concept's copy literally would require migrations and code changes; decide before building.

LAYOUT SCHEMA EVOLUTION. Renaming or removing widgets, or changing their spans, invalidates stored layouts. Use layout_version with a tolerant parser that drops unknown ids, clamps sizes to the allowed presets and falls back to registry defaults. Two tabs editing the same layout cause last-write-wins; use an updated_at check.

SIZE MODEL AMBIGUITY. S/M/L/XL map to different spans per widget (S = 3×2 or 4×2; M = 4×3, 5×3 or 7×3). The admin boards use spans outside the four classes (2×2, 4×4, 5×4, 6×3, 7×4, 7×5, 8×5, 4×5). Only Recent routines has a full S–XL spec. Every other widget's S/L/XL content in this map is a proposal derived from the board's rules and needs design sign-off.

PROTOTYPE DEFECTS TO AVOID. The filter chips, routine chips and footers in the prototype are non-interactive spans. Row grids per row misalign the L/XL columns. The S picker has no menu. The size badges look like UI but are annotations. Hrefs are self-referencing placeholders ('Sizes.dc.html', 'Main.dc.html').
